user_goal: Broaden the language rewrite substantially while preserving existing logic and outputs, with measured performance as the objective and frequent durable Git checkpoints.
scope: Complete excerpt-window candidate generation, source-unit coverage, sliding counts, score comparison and rendering
Batch candidate scoring/sorting and novelty selection, character-budget allocation and reference clipping
Conversation turns, source-preserving joining, page cuts, page construction and section grouping
Token-budget source-unit extraction, source-map certification and projection

implementation.language: C through the existing optional CPython extension
implementation.organization: Separate _native_*.h implementation units included by one _native.c extension; explicit build dependencies and packaged source bytes
implementation.fallback: Retain original Python bodies for differential verification, unsupported runtimes, customized helpers and unusual argument types
implementation.python_retained: CLI, MCP and client adapters, service management, database/schema/transaction control, exact tokenizer/model runtimes and public interfaces

invariants: No SQL, schema, retrieval-policy, ranking-weight, scope, identity, pagination, budget, cache-policy or tokenizer change
Preserve Unicode code-point offsets, source reconstruction, term order/frequency and exact stable payloads
Preserve float operation order, math.log1p/math.fsum behavior, stable tie ordering and Python integer semantics
Preserve supported dynamic overrides, callback order, reference identities, mutation behavior and original errors through guarded dispatch
No change to frozen v0.8.0/v0.8.1 evaluators, plans or evidence
Do not infer runtime performance from repository language percentages or helper-only microbenchmarks

verification.baseline_profile: Read-only cProfile on frozen native v0.8.1 with an in-memory database and before/after source and binary hashes
verification.differential: Independent preserved Python oracle tests for every migrated family, including malformed/custom input fallback, Unicode, ties, callback order and actual native dispatch
verification.integration: Full existing Python/MCP/reader/installer/container CI plus complete output, archive and source-coordinate comparison
verification.formal: Freeze a separate protocol-3 evaluator and candidate before timing. Compare native v0.8.1 with the candidate using balanced sequential A/B rounds, both existing cohorts, direct recall and real SDK MCP, all character/token configurations, ingestion and resources.
verification.preservation: Retain all attempts and raw records in immutable Git evidence, including failed and unfavorable diagnostics; keep compact audited reports with the implementation
verification.delivery: Fresh exact-commit 30-wheel matrix, runtime/source/build provenance, Python fallback, default-extras installers and actual public-release installation

decision: Adopt only after exact recorded behavior equivalence and repeatable end-to-end benefits justify the complete measured tradeoffs. Publish all secondary regressions and costs. More native source or a successful compilation alone is not acceptance.
